info.title: Rock Is a Lady's Modesty
info.synopsis: Lilisa Suzunomiya è una ragazza appassionata di chitarra e della musica rock, che si ritrova a diventare figlia di un magnate immobiliare dopo il nuovo matrimonio della madre. Mandata in una prestigiosa scuola femminile dove si riuniscono le ragazze di tutto il paese, si ritrova costretta ad accantonare le sue passioni per comportarsi in modo signorile come il resto delle studentesse. Fino a quando non incontra Otoha Kurogane, una delle ragazze più altolocate della scuola, che condivide l'amore per la musica e si rivela anche un'abile batterista. Dopo una jam session fra le due, la passione che sembrava sparita in Lilisa si riaccende... riusciranno queste ragazze che devono vivere una vita da donne raffinate a fare scintille grazie al rock?

episodes.title: Good Day to You / Quit That Guitar Already!!!
episodes.synopsis: Lilisa had to adapt to her new life of privilege and pretended to be someone she wasn't at Oushin Girls Academy. That is, until she catches Otoha drumming in the music room.

episodes.title: Let`s Collaborate! / I Will Never Admit to That!
episodes.synopsis: Lilisa wants absolutely nothing to do with Otoha anymore. Unfortunately for her, that's easier said than done since the drummer refuses to leave her alone.

episodes.title: Let`s Do It! Let`s Do What Feels Good! / Wanna Start a Band?
episodes.synopsis: Lilisa's love of rock roars back to life during a jam session. She may pretend otherwise, but once unleashed, her repressed spirit will not back down without a fight.

episodes.title: Want to Use a Peer Seeker? / I`ll Get Them Thrown Out!
episodes.synopsis: Alice despises her new sister and mother and is determined to drive them out of her home. Meanwhile, Lilisa and Otoha start their search for new band members.

episodes.title: My Heart Is Racing / Whip Yours Out, Too!
episodes.synopsis: Lilisa and Otoha vow to wipe that cocky grin straight off Jun's stupid face with a performance to remember! Little do they know, however, that Alice is in the audience.

episodes.title: Will You Let Me Join Your Band? / Get Rid of Her, Immediately
episodes.synopsis: The Prince of Oushin is renowned by the entire school, but she's hiding a secret, just like Lilisa. Meanwhile, Otoha receives an unexpected offer from an old friend.

episodes.title: I Want to Change! / Get on My Level, Friggin` Noob
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to Otoha, the four band members will participate in a battle of the bands. Tina shows no signs of improving and talks of kicking her out begin.

episodes.title: In No Way Is That a Waste! / I Have a Secret Plan!
episodes.synopsis: Five days—if Tina can improve in five days then she can stay in the band. Lilisa will make sure of it.

episodes.title: It Is Finally Our Turn / You`re All Too Loud!
episodes.synopsis: The battle of the bands kicks off and their problems immediately begin. Tina is out of sync, and Lilisa's performance stands out in a bad way.

episodes.title: I Know You Can Do Way Better Than That / I Wanna Rock Out with Them Again
episodes.synopsis: Tempers flare after a crushing defeat, but not for the expected reason. Tamaki finally understands why Otoha chose Lilisa over her and has an important decision to make.

episodes.title: I Want to Be the Noble Maiden / It Lets You Dance All over Them
episodes.synopsis: As Lilisa strives to become a refined lady for her mother's sake, she unexpectedly encounters a former student who has been honored with the title of Noble Maiden.

episodes.title: I Will Bow Out of Playing / We`ll Prove We`re the Best!
episodes.synopsis: Lilisa and the others gear up for their final shot to rock the Live House, resolved to take down the boy band Bacchus.

episodes.title: Rock Lady
episodes.synopsis: Rebellion is the soul of rock, so who cares what anyone thinks? Rock Lady's passion roars through every beat, and they'll prove it to Bacchus, the crowd, and themselves.

info.title: Bloody Escape: Jigoku no Tousou Geki
info.synopsis: Dopo che la sperimentazione umana ha trasformato Kizaragi in un cyborg, il protagonista si ritrova perseguitato da più organizzazioni: un gruppo immortale di vampiri deciso alla conquista di Tokyo, un ordine immortale di cavalieri e un gruppo di Yakuza, intenti a vendicare l'uccisione del loro capo. "Potrei non avere alcun motivo per vivere, ma non è un motivo per lasciare che mi uccidano." Kizaragi dovrà usare il suo corpo da cyborg e il suo "sangue" per fuggire!

info.title: Hell Teacher Nube: Summer Holiday of Fear! Legend of the Sea of Suspicion
info.synopsis: Quando Nube e la sua classe arrivano su una piccola isola per svolgere attività sulla spiaggia, sentono un racconto inquietante da un vecchio che vive sull’isola. La leggenda narra che, nei mari aperti intorno all’isola, esiste una creatura conosciuta come il ragno marino. Quando questa creatura supera i 200 anni, si trasforma in un mostro e divora esseri umani per placare il suo appetito. Tuttavia, la curiosità è pericolosa e Yukime decide di indagare sulla veridicità della leggenda. Improvvisamente, una ragazza appare sulla spiaggia. Possedendo uno strano fascino, attira subito l’attenzione di Hiroshi e riesce a sedurlo. Poco dopo, iniziano ad accadere eventi strani: Kyoko e la professoressa Ritsuko vengono attaccate in circostanze misteriose. L’identità della ragazza misteriosa viene messa in discussione e la leggenda della creatura marina sembra essere vera dopotutto.

episodes.title: Hell Teacher Nube Movie - Summer Holiday of Fear! Legend of the Sea of Suspicion
episodes.synopsis: When Nube and his class arrive at a small island to carry out beach activities, they heard a forbodding tale from an old man residing on the island. Legend has it that there is a creature known as the sea spider in the open seas around the island. When the creature is past 200 years old, it will turn into a monster and devour humans to satisfy its appetite. However, curiousity kills the cat and Yukime decides to pursue the authenticity of the legend. And then, a girl suddenly appears on the beach. Possessed with a strange charm, she immediately attracts Hiroshi's attention and overcomes him. Soon later, strange things start to happen to the others whereby Kyoko and Ritsuko-sensei got attacked under strange circumstances. The true identity behind the mysterious girl is questioned and the legend behind the sea creature seems to be true after all.

episodes.title: You Won`t Get Away with This!
episodes.synopsis: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

episodes.title: That`s, Like, Way Deadly

episodes.title: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!
episodes.synopsis: As Momo and the others try to pilot the giant Buddha robot and battle the kaiju, Okarun and Jiji are ejected from the robot and land in a rice paddy.

info.title: Ken il guerriero - La leggenda del vero salvatore
info.synopsis: Questo film costituisce il quinto e ultimo capitolo della pentalogia intitolata Ken il guerriero - La leggenda. Kenshiro, il successore della Divina Scuola di Hokuto, è stato sconfitto da Shin, il successore del Pugno dell'Aquila Solitaria di Nanto. Quest’ultimo, dopo aver rapito l’amata Julia, gli ha inflitto sul torace sette profonde ferite, disposte come le sette stelle dell’Orsa Maggiore. Dopo il tragico episodio, Ken viene catturato da una banda di mercanti di schiavi e portato in una città fortezza controllata con la forza daI governatore Siska. Kenshiro viene imprigionato, costretto a un duello in un’arena e crocefisso. Provato nel fisico e nell’anima, grazie all’incontro con Fugen, un anziano maestro di arti marziali, Ken riesce a trovare il coraggio necessario per reagire ed adempiere al suo destino. Così, mentre la città viene presa in assedio da Jugai, un guerriero ribelle della scuola di Nanto, Kenshiro decide di intervenire e di porre fine ai soprusi. Questa battaglia segna l'inizio del lungo cammino che porterà Ken a diventare il tanto atteso Salvatore.

episodes.title: La leggenda di Toki
episodes.synopsis: Il piccolo Toki viene adottato da Ryuken insieme al fratello Raoul, ma si occupa delle faccende domestiche, limitandosi a spiare gli allenamenti massacranti del fratello; eppure un giorno stende un cacciatore che gli ha ucciso il cagnolino, grazie alle mosse che imparato guardando di nascosto; Ryuken lo ferma e capisce che ha un talento naturale, così gli chiede se vuole apprendere la Divina Scuola di Hokuto, ricordandogli che da grande dovrà battersi con Raoul per la successione; Toki accetta, desideroso di avvicinarsi al fratello. Anni dopo, Julia e Kenshiro osservano la tecnica di Toki ormai affinata a dovere; Ken la paragona ad una danza, ma Raoul contesta sostenendo che sia il ballo del Dio della Morte. Ryuken è quasi convinto di voler nominare Toki successore, poiché si avvicinano per il mondo tempi bui e la forza di Hokuto sarà presto necessaria. Sara, una giovane donna che vive con loro, pressata da Ryuken, rivela che Toki si è ammalato. Scoppia la guerra atomica; Toki, Kenshiro e Julia corrono ad un rifugio, ma non c'è posto per tutti; Toki spinge i due giovani dentro e resta fuori esposto al pulviscolo radioattivo. In queste condizioni, rinuncia alla successione e prende la decisione di aiutare i malati con le conoscenze dei punti di pressione; Sara lo segue facendogli da assistente ed scrivendo molte nozioni che Toki le spiega oralmente. Stacco temporale. Dopo la sconfitta di Souther, è ora che Raoul e Toki si affrontino; prima che accada Toki promette a Sara (ormai chiaramente innamorata di lui) di tornare da lei; il secondogenito di Hokuto si affida a lei per colpire un particolare punto segreto, e la pressione esercitata provoca a Toki un dolore immenso che senbra arrivare fino al cielo. Il duello tra Toki e Raoul avviene non lontano dalle tombe che i due hanno costruito per i genitori, assieme ad altre due per se stessi. L'inizio sembra in parità ma presto il vantaggio passa a Raoul, libero da preoccupazioni e più in forma del frate

Che legame c'è tra questi eventi drammatici e la semplice attrice che Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura e Kakashi devono proteggere?

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: After a rousing game of hide-n-seek with Konohamaru, Naruto and the gang are on the next big mission. Their task is to escort the beautiful actress Fujimi Yukihime to a far off mountain where the sequel to last summer`s mega box office smash hit movie is being filmed. Upon their arrival, ghosts show up and try to scare everyone anyway from the movie set. Everyone is confused why they would want the movie to stop being made; so Naruto and the gang vow to find out who is behind the scarings and capture them.

info.title: Renegade Immortal
info.synopsis: Wang Lin, un giovane della campagna, decide di intraprendere la via dell’immortalità. La sua ricerca non mira solo alla longevità, ma anche a liberarsi delle minacce che lo circondano. Convinto del valore dell'uomo, inizia il suo percorso di crescita spirituale e potenziamento personale nonostante le capacità inizialmente modeste. Attraverso sfide e difficoltà, con la sua intelligenza e determinazione, riesce gradualmente a raggiungere l'apice, guadagnandosi fama e rispetto nel mondo dei praticanti grazie esclusivamente alle proprie forze.

info.title: You and I Are Polar Opposites
info.synopsis: Miyu Suzuki è una studentessa delle superiori brillante e frizzante che ha una cotta. C'è un piccolo problema: quando si tratta di personalità gli piacciono sempre i ragazzi che sono il suo esatto opposto! Mentre lei è sempre allegra, estroversa e con un grande spirito di adattamento, il suo compagno di classe Yusuke Tani è sempre impassibile e silenzioso. Senza contare che dice senza problemi ciò che pensa e non gli importa nulla di quello che la gente pensa di lui. Riuscirà Miyu a superare le sue ansie per chiedere a Yusuke di uscire oppure scoprirà che gli opposti non si attraggono realmente?

episodes.title: You, My Polar Opposite
episodes.synopsis: Suzuki is always cheerful and energetic, but she often worries about what the people around her think of her. That's why she secretly admires Tani, the quiet boy who sits next to her in class, for always clearly speaking his mind. One day after school, the two of them end up walking home together, and then...

episodes.title: First Date!
episodes.synopsis: After their confessions of love are successful, Suzuki and Tani begin dating. Suzuki wants to impress Tani on their first date, a date she's wished for for so long, but she feels like she just keeps spinning her wheels.

episodes.title: Cute and Cool
episodes.synopsis: Knowledge of Suzuki and Tani's relationship slowly spreads through their class. When Suzuki calls Tani "adorable," it leaves him feeling unsettled and wondering what she means by that word.

episodes.title: Summer Night Vibes
episodes.synopsis: Suzuki organizes a study group for their end of term exams. She's happy to see Tani is growing closer to her friends. Then, at last, the day of the summer festival arrives.

episodes.title: Someone Who Thinks and Someone Who Doesn`t
episodes.synopsis: Yamada is touched by the shy, reserved Nishi's smile and gradually becomes interested in her. He decides to jump right in and say, "Be my friend!" Little by little, they grow closer.

episodes.title: Culture Festival!
episodes.synopsis: With the close of summer break, the culture festival arrives. Suzuki reunites with Rihito, a boy she dated in middle school.

episodes.title: Fluttery Confusion
episodes.synopsis: After the culture festival, an undefined sort of atmosphere hangs between Yamada and Nishi. Suzuki notices and begins plotting. Tani finds himself left at the mercy of the situation.

episodes.title: This Autumn...
episodes.synopsis: The culture festival is over and the season turns to autumn. Azuma is troubled by a message from her ex-boyfriend, and Taira defends Azuma's feelings in her stead. Little by little their relationship is changing.

episodes.title: Surprise!
episodes.synopsis: For Tani's birthday, he and Suzuki go on a museum date. Despite being struck with crowds and other trouble, they express their feelings to each other and grow closer.

episodes.title: Class Trip (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis: At last it's time for the class trip. The girls in her class pelt Suzuki with questions about her relationship with Tani. Suzuki confesses her true feelings to Azuma, saying, "I want to take things further with Tani."

episodes.title: Class Trip (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis: On the second day of the class trip, Nishi gets a message from Yamada saying "I want to see you." She heads out and finally realizes her true feelings. On the last day of the trip, Tani and Suzuki enjoy their time at a theme park, but Tani stops her from leaving and says, "I want to spend a little more time with you."

episodes.title: Step by Step
episodes.synopsis: As the seasons change, Yamada and Nishi become more open with each other, and the negative aura around Azuma and Taira continues to soften. Suzuki and Tani go on a date in Yokohama, and the chance for their first kiss finally arrives, but...

info.title: Master Keaton
info.synopsis: Hiraga-Keaton Taichi è un uomo, figlio di un zoologo giapponese e di una donna inglese, il cui sogno è quello di portare alla luce un'antica civiltà sul fiume Danubio. Dopo la rottura con sua moglie perde però anche la fiducia nel suo sogno e si arruola nell'esercito britannico, in particolare nelle forze speciali SAS. Il suo desiderio legato all'archelogia tuttavia non si spegne e così, per finanziare il suo futuro scavo privato della civiltà segreta, gira il mondo come investigatore assicurativo per i Lloyd's di Londra.

info.title: Babil Junior
info.synopsis: Koichi è un ragazzo apparentemente comune che ultimamente è afflitto da sogni agitati. A causa di una voce misteriosa scopre nel deserto della Mesopotamia i resti della torre di Babele e scopre di essere stato a lungo atteso da Babil I, un alieno dall'avanzata tecnologia naufragato sulla Terra millenni prima. Dopo l'incontro Koichi diventa Babil Junior, un essere dotato di molti poteri psichici utili per proteggere la terra dai mortali nemici che vogliono conquistarla, tra cui Yomi, un altro potente ESPER a capo di una setta che vuole assoggettare l'umanità. Ad aiutare Babil Jr nella sua missione ci sono tre potenti servitori: la loquace pantera mutaforme Roden, il possente robot impermeabile Poseidon, e lo pterodattilo metallico Ropuros, oltre a poter usufruire del supporto del calcolatore elettronico nella torre di Babele.

episodes.title: Cinquemila anni dopo
episodes.synopsis: Koichi was taken over by the Komi family and grew up as an ordinary high school student. But he was the successor to the "Spice Curry Tower" in the Old Testament! Koichi, who knew that he would be invited there from his dreams every day, overcame the opposition of Mr. and Mrs. Furumi and his daughter, Yumiko, and visited the Tower of Babil, which stands quietly in the desert near Baghdad.

episodes.title: Il gigante di roccia
episodes.synopsis: After contacting Babel II and feeling that he would be his enemy, Yomi immediately ordered his men who believed in him. And he tried to find out the position of Babel's tower, which could not be read by his telepathic ability, by letting his subordinates fight.

episodes.title: L`imperatore delle tenebre
episodes.synopsis: Still worried about Koichi's whereabouts, the Furumi family found his name in the inquirer section of a newspaper ad. It was issued by Sonomiya, who was a classmate with Koichi, but Yomi used the advertisement. He sent his subordinates Robinson and Jobby to try to hold Babel II's breath with his close friends. (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: Three Servants
episodes.synopsis: Lobotomy surgery to brainwash humans by surgery, which was revealed by analyzing the corpse of Yomi's subordinate Joby. Yomi is concerned that Dr. Kuraishi and his assistant, Arai, who were involved in the analysis, knew too much about the secret, and planned to make them loyal subordinates by performing surgery on them as well. (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: This is Telekinesis!
episodes.synopsis: Fake Babel II attacked banks around the world. Babel II was unable to measure Yomi's true intentions, but it was a time-earning strategy aimed at disturbing him. Behind the scenes, a field was steadily being built to separate the three servants from Babel II. He is taken to a jet plane and the telepathy to his servants is cut off. Babel II big pinch! (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: The Crisis Close Call Babil Tower
episodes.synopsis: Babel II defeated Yomi, but his exhaustion was also severe. That was when the Tigris army deployed around the Babil Tower. Babel II returns to the treatment pod to recover his strength, thinking it was just an exercise at first. However, it was Yomi's minions who thought he had defeated him, and was a unit deployed to seek out the Tower of Babil.

episodes.title: Another Commander
episodes.synopsis: A large passenger plane crashed. The only survivor is the Commander General of the National Security Bureau. However, Yumiko, who was waiting for her daughter Kinko and Babel II, Koichi, to return, suspects that he is "like a different person." What is the identity of the commander who nominates Yumiko and Kinko as bodyguards as if to prove that suspicion, as if they were shields for Babel II? (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: Devil's Secret Base
episodes.synopsis: A neutron bomb blast experiment conducted on the west coast of Africa. Babel II was terrified by the power of another nuclear bomb, which has no physical destructive power and kills only humans with powerful radiation. Moreover, it is said that only Yomi has the scientific power to make it, so he immediately sets out to investigate.

episodes.title: The Rocky Mountains of Horror
episodes.synopsis: Yomi's hypnotic user, Joseph, used an announcer to summon Babel II to the Rocky Mountains of Canada. Babel II was attacked by the villagers as soon as he arrived at the village at the foot of the Rocky Mountains because Joseph hypnotized nearby villagers. (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: Deadly Robot Baran
episodes.synopsis: A sand storm that covers the Tower of Babil. The generation system, which is the greatest defense measure, has been put in place. Yomi's reconnaissance aircraft that comes only at such times. It seemed that he had escaped from the crisis by being driven away by Lopros, but the first strike from Babel II would conversely teach the place. (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: Android Two-Stage Attack
episodes.synopsis: A new type of virus weapon X3 developed by Yomi's subordinates. The virus contaminated California Orange, causing a fuss around the world. Moreover, Yomi's subordinate disguised himself as a witness and testified that Babel II had spread the virus, making him hostile to humans around the world.

episodes.title: Robot transmission machine X1
episodes.synopsis: An old man who had fallen down in the desert. It was Dr. Roald Dali, one of the world's leading scientists, who went missing two years ago. Dr. Yomi, who was captured by Yomi, was working on the development of a mechanical machine X1 that can copy a combat robot and transmit it in any size, and decided to escape due to guilt. That's right.

episodes.title: Regain the Artificial Satellite
episodes.synopsis: An artificial satellite that deviated from orbit crashed in Japan. The military was supposed to recover it, but it was attacked by combatants under Yomi and robbed of the artificial satellite. In fact, the artificial satellite had a new type of guidance device built-in, which was a ridiculous thing that could be used to bomb anywhere from outer space.

episodes.title: Dangerous !! Phantom Bird Lopros
episodes.synopsis: A dragon that raids Eskimos. It was a new robot weapon developed by Yomi for anti-Lopros. Yomi was searching for weaknesses from the battle data with Lopros while attacking Babel II who rushed to the site with a bear type robot and a seal type robot. However, when he learned that no weaknesses were found, he launched a full-scale attack.

episodes.title: Notre Dame Madness Case
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious luminous panic that hit Paris. This phenomenon, which explodes when you think that the headlights of a car suddenly emit intense light, was once again the work of Yomi. However, the operation was not yet in the execution stage, and it happened because Professor Saint Clair, who was in charge of spearheading the operation, accidentally touched the device. (C) Hikari Pro / Toei Animation

episodes.title: Phantom 100 trillion yen
episodes.synopsis: Fake bills suddenly scattered all over the city. It was so elaborate that even if an expert appraised it, it would not be recognized as a fake bill. If this flows into the market, there will definitely be a financial panic and Japan will be economically destroyed. However, Yomi, who made the fake bill, threatened the director of the National Security Bureau.

episodes.title: The Challenge of Blindness
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious power outage that hit all over the world. This simultaneous and frequent panic literally paralyzed social life. Moreover, the world's major cities become lawless areas, such as robbers rampant in the darkness. Meanwhile, Babel II, who was ordered by Yomi, the mastermind of the case, to come to the North Pole, was told to crush the servants there.

episodes.title: Whistling demons
episodes.synopsis: The people watching TV suddenly became violent. People who had lived a normal social life until then, but panicked because they suddenly changed like "Jekyll and Hyde". At that time, Babel II, who embarked on an investigation, found that Tokyo Tower was the source of the violent sound waves, but even Rodem was mad and forced to withdraw temporarily.

episodes.title: Mammoth Gorilla Raid
episodes.synopsis: A mammoth gorilla appeared in the jungle of New Guinea and attacked the inhabitants. Babel II, who was invited by Yomi, meets a victim girl, Ami, and his younger brother, Pero, who was in danger of blindness due to the attack, and a Japanese doctor, Shirakawa. In fact, he was a former teacher of Shirakawa and Yumiko's father, and here he was a well-known doctor called Schweizer in Japan.

episodes.title: Dreadful Space Operation
episodes.synopsis: A meteorite fell into the Arabian Sea. Babel II, who set out to investigate in Poseidon, learns that it was an artificial meteorite and that Yomi developed the meteorite bomb. If the innumerable meteorites floating in the universe are abused, the earth will be destroyed by Yomi immediately ... Babel II, who has a sense of crisis, rushes to a tent village in a certain country, relying on the mysterious telepathy that calls himself. It was.

episodes.title: Baby is a Supernatural Power
episodes.synopsis: A baby with a mysterious power that is famous in the neighborhood of the Komi family. Yomi looked at the baby. Babel II desperately pursues his whereabouts when he learns that a baby with the same telepathic ability as himself has been taken away by Yomi. However, it collapses due to the damage inflicted by the tank unit's attack.

episodes.title: Deep Sea Crab Rrobot
episodes.synopsis: A plan to build an undersea city that was underway on the seabed of the Sea of Japan. However, Yomi, who already had an undersea base, sent a huge crab robot to destroy the base under construction. Babel II, who reunites with the director of security, takes action to defeat the crab robot and remove Yomi's obstruction.

episodes.title: Invitation from The Ghost
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious telepathy sent to Babel II and Yomi at the same time. Babel II discovers that it originates from a volcanic island and discovers an old man, Doctor Salz, with powerful psychic powers on the scene. However, the old man had already died, and he was sending telepathy with only residual thoughts using a mental power amplifier.

episodes.title: Eternal City Frozen Zoro
episodes.synopsis: Yomi's subordinate, Gorda, discovers the ancient civilized city of Zoro. Originally, Gorda became a subordinate as a human being, but gained the ability to move at an unstoppable speed by the accelerator discovered at the ruins of Zoro. He no longer challenges Babel II with the ability to surpass cyborg warriors and psychic soldiers.

episodes.title: Operation V of Death
episodes.synopsis: Yomi created the ultimate machine to make Babel II dead. Its name is "V"! It is Yomi's trump card that has finally been completed by stealing a large number of high-performance LSIs that make even a TV palm-sized. Yomi, who launched the newly completed V, succeeds in causing great damage to Babel II, who has chased to the secret base.
